title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railroad Logistics Industry
title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON THE PROMOTION AND SUPPORT OF THE RAILROAD LOGISTICS INDUSTRY

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railroad Logistics Industry and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Minor Amendments)
"Minor matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the proviso to Article 6 (1) of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railroad Logistics Industry (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means any of the following:
1. Changing the amount of investment in railroad logistics facilities prescribed in the railroad logistics industry promotion plan under Article 5 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "railroad logistics plan") within 10 percent;
2. Changing detailed matters included in the railroad logistics plan within a scope that does not affect its basic direction.

Article 3 (Standards for Designation of Hub Stations, etc.)
(1) The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may designate as a railroad freight station serving as a hub under Article 9 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "hub station") a railroad freight station meeting all of the following requirements:
1. It is adjacent to any of the following facilities where freight volume prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport occurs or is expected to occur:
(a) Logistics facilities under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (b) of the Act;
(b) Industrial complexes under Article 2, subparagraph 8 of the Industrial Sites and Development Act;
(c) Ports under Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Harbor Act;
2. Improvement, consolidation, etc. of the railroad freight station is necessary to improve freight transport efficiency, including linkage between railroads and other transportation means.
(2) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to designate a hub station pursuant to Article 9 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall collect opinions from interested persons, including railroad logistics business operators and shippers.
(3) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport designates a hub station pursuant to Article 9 (1) of the Act, the Minister shall publicly notify the designation in the Official Gazette.
(4) A person engaged in railroad freight transportation under Article 2, subparagraph 4 (a) of the Act who intends to receive support for costs necessary for improvement, consolidation, etc. of a hub station shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, accompanied by the following:
1. A business plan including project details, scale, and costs;
2. Documents explaining the effects of improvement, consolidation, etc. of the hub station;
3. Documents stating measures to alleviate inconvenience to users of the hub station, including shippers and railroad logistics business operators.
(5) Matters necessary for standards and methods for designating hub stations and for cost support, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (4), shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

Article 4 (Standards for Bearing Costs of Relocating Railroad Logistics Facilities)
(1) Pursuant to Article 10 (2) of the Act, relocation costs of railroad logistics facilities that may be borne by a project implementer under the Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities or by a person requesting railroad construction shall be as follows: <Amended on March 12, 2019>
1. Costs of relocating railroad facilities under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a) of the Act, limited to railroad facilities of dedicated railways under Article 2, subparagraph 5 of the Railroad Business Act;
2. Costs of relocating logistics facilities under Article 2 (1) 4 (a) and (b) of the Framework Act on Logistics Policies.
(2) The costs borne under paragraph (1) shall not exceed the amount obtained by subtracting the appraised value of the existing railroad logistics facilities from the total costs incurred by a railroad logistics business operator, excluding the Korea Railroad Corporation, in relocating the facilities pursuant to Article 10 (2) of the Act. The appraised value means the arithmetic mean of values assessed by at least two appraisal corporations, etc. under the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers before relocation. <Amended on January 21, 2022>

Article 5 (Standards for Construction of Industrial Sidings)
The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Do Governor, or Special Self-Governing Province Governor may construct an industrial siding pursuant to Article 11 (1) of the Act where all of the following requirements are met:
1. Freight volume prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport occurs or is expected to occur;
2. A logistics facility under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (b) of the Act capable of transporting the freight volume under subparagraph 1 exists or is planned to be constructed.

Article 6 (Promotion of Railroad Freight Transportation)
Pursuant to Article 16 (2) of the Act, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may provide administrative and financial support to a person intending to transport by railroad vehicle any freight falling under a subparagraph of Article 16 (1) of the Act with respect to the following:
1. Installation of logistics facilities under Article 2 (1) 4 (a) of the Framework Act on Logistics Policies;
2. Research and development to improve the efficiency of railroad freight transportation.

Article 7 (Subsidization of Costs)
(1) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport subsidizes costs for a railroad logistics business operator pursuant to Article 17 (1) of the Act, the Minister may provide support within budgetary limits, taking into account the necessity and effectiveness of the project.
(2) A railroad logistics business operator that intends to receive a subsidy pursuant to Article 17 (1) of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport an application prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, accompanied by the following:
1. A business plan including project details, scale, and costs;
2. Documents explaining the effect of implementing a project under any subparagraph of Article 17 (1) of the Act on the efficiency of railroad freight transportation.
(3) Matters necessary for subsidization of costs, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

Article 8 (Reduction or Exemption of Charges)
Where a railroad logistics business operator carries out a project under Article 17 (1) 1 or 2 of the Act, the State or a local government may reduce or exempt the following charges in accordance with the National Land Planning and Utilization Act, the Special Act on Designation and Management of Development Restriction Zones, the Grassland Act, and the Sewerage Act:
1. Infrastructure installation costs under Article 68 of the National Land Planning and Utilization Act;
2. Charges for conservation of development restriction zones under Article 21 of the Special Act on Designation and Management of Development Restriction Zones;
3. Costs for creation of substitute grassland under Article 23 of the Grassland Act;
4. Sewerage facilities burden charges under Article 61 of the Sewerage Act.

Article 9 (Standards for Designation of International Railroad Freight Transportation Business Operators)
The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may designate a railroad freight transportation business operator as an international railroad freight transportation business operator pursuant to Article 18 (1) of the Act where all of the following requirements are met:
1. Capital of at least five billion won;
2. Total liabilities not exceeding twice the capital;
3. A record of railroad freight transportation within the preceding five years.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 27509, September 22, 2016>

This Decree shall enter into force on September 23, 2016.

ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities) <Presidential Decree No. 29617, March 12, 2019>

Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)

In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 4 (1), "Railroad Construction Act" shall be replaced with "Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities."

<30> through <33> Omitted.

Omitted.
